fields: [pic=4]Oh Rascal. Did you notice our sweet digs?
[pic=4]Custom fit, robust and efficient stitching, and stylish to bat!
[pic=3]I have to admit… we make a pretty good team.
[pic=4]Your designs wouldn’t work without my foundation and technique.
[pic=7]Vi, no one’s gonna wanna WEAR ‘solid foundation and technique.’
[pic=7]Are you saying I can’t make it LOOK good?
Heyyyy, let’s take a step back.
[pic=3]Eh heh, Rascal don’t mind our bickering.
[pic=1]We get under each other’s skin, but we’re besties to the core.
[pic=3]Can’t live with her, can’t live without her.
[pic=2]So we’re seamstresses. It’s what we do when we aren’t fooling around.
[pic=1]Have you made your way up north? Toward the mountains?
[pic=3]Ah, well it’s cold as HELL up there.
[pic=5]Despite being covered in fur, it gets pretty bad up there.
[pic=2]That is, until we made these stylish clothes.
[pic=4]Help us get some material, and we can make ya a cute sweater!
[pic=5]We’ve got some friends up there, and it was pretty rough visiting them before…
[pic=1]We’ve got all the tools, so all we actually need is the cloth.
[pic=6]We’d usually get it from the shop, but they’ve been out of stock forever.
[pic=2]So these days we get it from Finley, have you met him?
[pic=5]You’ll find him off on his own.
[pic=1]He’ll be more than happy to lend you some of his wool.
[pic=3]You just need to bring some shears…
[pic=7]Hmmm… Vi… have you seen the shears?
[pic=4]Well Rascal, looks like it’ll be up to you to secure a pair!
[pic=2]Come back and see us when you’ve got some wool!
[pic=3]I’ll get thinking on what colors to make this!
[pic=7]Whattya think Vi, a brown? Maybe a yellow?
[pic=4]Yes, but what it’s nice to play with that contrast.
[pic=6]But we don’t want to go too loud.
[pic=5]Could I pull off such a loud ensemble off? Absolutely.
[pic=3]But I think it’s best to go with something that’ll match his calm demeanor…
